Name: Alex Dialogue for The Stardew Squad
Author: elee7420
Description:
[size=5][b]Alex Dialogue for The Stardew Squad Mod

[/b][/size][size=4][b]✨About This Mod

[/b][/size]This mod adds 300+ lines of original dialogue for Alex, written exclusively for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url]. It is a faithful expansion that builds on Alex's established canon personality, history, and emotional arc. Beyond the surface-level jock persona, this dialogue reveals a loyal, caring companion with strong family values and quiet emotional depth—while remaining fully true to Alex's character.[line][size=4][b]✨ What This Mod Does

[/b][/size]• Adds 300+ lines of handcrafted, context-aware dialogue

• Expands Alex's emotional depth while staying fully in-character

• Integrates seamlessly with The Stardew Squad companion system[line][size=4][b]💬 Character Development

[/b][/size]Alex's dialogue evolves naturally across three relationship stages:

[b]Low Hearts (Acquaintance)
[/b]Confident and guarded, with subtle hints of vulnerability beneath the surface.

[b]High Hearts (Close Friend / Romantic)
[/b]More open and reflective. Alex shares concerns about family, Dusty, and his appreciation for simple, shared moments.

[b]Spouse
[/b]A devoted and affectionate partner—protective, playful, and fully committed to building a life together.[line][size=4][b]🔧 Compatibility & Notes

[/b][/size]• Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] by ThaliaFawnheart

• Compatible with most canon-friendly Alex mods

• Safe to add to or remove from existing saves

[size=4][b]🛠 Future Plans

[/b][/size]This is the first in a planned series of dialogue packs for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url]. Future character packs are planned for:
• Sebastian• Sam • Elliott • Shane• Abigail• Emily• Penny[line][size=4][b]🌏 Localization Plans

[/b][/size]Chinese translation planned for all dialogue packs listed above.[line][size=4][b]💙 Special Thanks

[/b][/size]A huge thank you to [b]ThaliaFawnheart[/b], creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url], for making this mod possible.
[line]
This project began as a personal passion project, and I would like to share it with players who want their NPC companions to feel unique and special as much as I do.

Enjoy your time with Alex!
